channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: 🚀 Houston, We Have Liftoff! 🚀
item.description: Join us for Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium as we embark on a stellar badminton journey. From adult recruits to junior cadets, it's a night of fun, fitness, and fantastic adventures!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Last Thursday Club Night of September
item.description: Join us for a fun-filled badminton night at Claremont Stadium. Perfect for beginners and improvers, with seasoned players sharing their tips. All 4 courts are ready for action!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Join Us for a Fun Thursday at Claremont Stadium!
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for a fun and pressure-free badminton session for beginners and improvers. Laughs, exercise, and potential badminton superpowers await!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Thursday Club Night Special at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for a beginner-friendly and improver-focused evening at Claremont Stadium, filled with laughter, coaching, and a waffle lot of fun!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night - Back Again!
item.description: Join us for another exciting Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium, where we're serving up more fun and action on the courts than Ireland did against Armenia on the field.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night is Back at Claremont Stadium!
item.description: Join us for a night of badminton and laughter at Claremont Stadium. All skill levels welcome!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Final Club Night of the 2024/2025 Season!
item.description: Join us for the final Club Night of the season for an evening of fun before wrapping up.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🐰 Happy Easter!

item.description: Join us for Wednesday Club Night with exciting badminton matches and open courts for practice. Fun for all ages and skill levels.

item.title: Roll Up, Shuttlecock Smashers! Week 3 of Summer Club
item.description: Join us for Week 3 of our Summer Club tonight from 8 PM to 11 PM at Claremont Stadium for a night full of fun, laughter, and badminton for just €8!
